ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels localized primarily on the right distal lobe and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe (image-left) is characterized by a solid low-intensity black region. The right lobe (image-right) displays dense, irregular high-contrast white mottling and focal spots concentrated along the outer margin and trailing edge, transitioning to solid black towards the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 40 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels, continuous along the trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the median notch towards the distal tips, terminating in jagged, irregular points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured protrusions (barnacles) are present at the distal tips of both lobes. Fine-grained dark speckling is visible within the white regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, light-colored linear streaks are visible on the left lobe and center-bottom region, appearing as thin, non-parallel disruptions in the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological encrustations (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips and multiple rake-like linear scars on the lower ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right fluke lobes; the right lobe contains a high density of white pattern features while the left is nearly monochromatic.
